lines.zh: 我游过河底，影子拉得很长
lines.en: I cross the riverbed, shadow long.

lines.zh: 两米多长的身子，水都让路
lines.en: Over two meters; the water yields.
My scales are like armor.
One tail beat carries me downstream.
I know this river's taste.
I move along the muddy bottom.
My back pattern looks like stone.
In shallows I turn slowly.
Thirty armor, all in the scales.
I surface for a gulp of air.

lines.zh: 水面上只露出我的背脊
lines.en: Only my back shows above water.
I swim steady, unhurried.
The school parts ahead of me.

lines.zh: 河湾深处是我常待的地方
lines.en: I keep to the deep bends.
My pectoral fins row slowly.
I've patrolled this river for years.
I hang in the water, still.
A hundred and four points; thick enough.

lines.zh: 水草缠上我的鳍，我懒得理
lines.en: Weeds snag my fin; I can't be bothered.
I wait for fish to come close.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我搅起来了
lines.en: I stir up the bottom mud.
I open my mouth, then close it.
The surface light flickers.
I'm longer than a boat.
Sound carries far underwater.
Hard scales, blunt teeth.
I needn't be fast; I'm big.
This bend has room for me alone.
I beat my tail slowly, holding place.
Old bones lie in the mud.

lines.zh: 岸上的你，在我眼里很小
lines.en: You up on the bank look small to me.
Step into the shallows and it's too late.
I'm far heavier than you.
In water I never hide.
Your shadow falls to the riverbed.
One tail beat raises a wave.
Walk the bank; I'll follow.

lines.zh: 你手里的钩子我看得见
lines.en: I see the hook in your hand.
I'm not an easy catch.
Stand back and I'll sink away.
A row of scales hangs loose on my flank.
Blood spreads through the murk.
One tail swing smashes half the weeds.

lines.zh: 我搅起泥，遮住自己的伤
lines.en: I churn the mud to hide my wound.
That grazed my gill cover.
I retreat to deeper water.
A hundred and four still takes damage.
I sink to the muddy bottom.
Hard to turn in water.
I'll keep this blow in mind.
I find my own food in water.
That bait is too fake.
Toss it down; let me look.

lines.zh: 漂着的死鱼，我不屑张嘴
lines.en: I won't open my mouth for floating carrion.
Hiding the hook won't help.

lines.zh: 这一口可能是最后一顿
lines.en: That bite could be my last.
I only take what drifts down.
You're standing too close to the edge.
River fish beat that.
Take it away; no interest.

lines.zh: 你撞上来的是三十点护甲
lines.en: What you hit was thirty points of armor.
I didn't shift a muscle.
The water rippled outward.
My back shoved you away.
This body is heavy.
Move; the bottom's narrow.
My tail sweeps you over.
You stepped on my back.
I take such knocks daily.
Don't swim along my flank.
At my age, not worth discussing.
The river matters more than anything.
I rarely meet my own kind.
There are no such rules in the water.
Grow as big as me first.
This river is enough for me.
You won't even enter the water.

lines.zh: 独来独往才养得出这身肉
lines.en: Growing this big takes solitude.
Don't muddy my water.
Go back to the bank.
Something on the riverbed.
I gulp it in.
This one sank.
I eat dead fish too.
I swing half a circle before moving in.
It's drifting in the water.
That's not half a meal.
I fan the mud with a fin.

lines.zh: 水里漂下来的都算我的
lines.en: Whatever drifts down here is mine.
Put your hand in and I'll take it for food.
You've entered the water.

lines.zh: 我转身慢，但很快到你面前
lines.en: Slow to turn, quick to arrive.
Thirty-nine; one hit is heavy.
Nothing in water has an escape.
I ram with my body.
The water drags at you.
My scales stop your blade.
The more you struggle, the slower you get.
This river has one master.
How many breaths can you hold?
I circle beneath your feet.
The water's clouding.
You can't see where I am.
My dorsal fin cuts the surface.
I swim right against you.
Swim for the bank and I'll shove.
No one comes to save you in water.
I needn't be fast; the water helps.
Mud under your feet.
A little deeper and you're mine.
I butt you with my head.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来压过去
lines.en: I turn broadside and press down.
My tail cracks through the water.
My scales rake your skin.
You're pulled under.

lines.zh: 这一撞带着整条河的重量
lines.en: This charge carries the river's weight.
I bite your arm.

lines.zh: 我的头把水面撞成一片白
lines.en: My head turns the water white.
You've backed into the shallows.
I stop there.
The surface churns once.

lines.zh: 我一动，浑水就翻起泥雾
lines.en: One move from me and the murk clouds with mud.
A large shadow joins the riverbed.
My scales darken in muddy water.
I take a gulp of air.
This river has room to turn.
I push the weeds aside.
I arrive, and the fish scatter.
The wet marks on the bank are mine.
I'm back in these waters.
The surface burns; I sink deeper.
I was thrown onto the bank.
Even in water I can stifle.
The blast muddied the riverbed.
Something stuck between my scales.
This force numbs my scales.
No fish in the river; I'm starving.
Lightning came through the water.
The water's gone; I can only slap my tail.
